items.title: Branford Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Leonard comes rushing up to me and he picks me up... Leonard Thomas. So I kissed him on his mouth... 'Sorry about that man. I was in character.'

ctx.x: Can you talk and type? Talk and search?

Yeah. I can do that. I’m just…it’s a thing, I gotta do it. I gotta do it. I gotta do it. I’m getting close. Let’s see. “Full cast and crew.” Ah, so George Patton…ah, Rusty, Rusty Condiff. So, at the beginning of the fight, Leonard comes rushing up to me and he picks me up, like this. And he’s about to body slam me, right in the middle of the shit. And I’m saying, “Think fast, think fast, so I…. Leonard Thomas. So I kissed him on his mouth and he went…. I said, “Put me down, motherfucker.” “You crazy man.” He was…
It was a decision you made on your own? You didn’t talk to other folks? Or…
